assets.title: Fixed-Incline Press Bench
assets.description: One original low-poly fixed-incline press bench, counted as one complete static prop. A separate short chamfered cushion and long 30-degree back cushion have complete thick closed bodies and independent flat underplates. A real visible seat-back gap remains. Two independent thick pierced hinge ears have genuine full-depth rectangular shaft openings; a continuous fixed sixteen-sided solid pin has integral end shoulders, finite lower seats in both holes and a finite upper face under the back tongue. A broad fixed rear wedge meets the back underplate across an entire finite inclined face. Four ground pads, two transverse feet, one low longitudinal beam and a front seat post form a connected support assembly. Eighteen closed editable meshes and four opaque unlinked constant PBR materials. Metres, native Z up, front -Y, horizontally bounds-centred ground origin. No barbell, rack, athlete, second angle, adjustment mechanism, animation, scene or textures. Newly authored short-seat/long-back geometry, not a recoloured public bench, bleacher row, rack or stretched rowing seat. Fixed static illustrative pose only: no adjustment, rotation, locking, friction, exercise suitability, body dimensions, comfort, load, strength, stability, injury prevention, manufacturing, installation, equipment standards or safety claim. No compatibility with historical barbell racks or other assets is asserted.
